title: A dimmer explosion
hook: Explore the evidence behind a cosmic question.

knows: Light and gravity help astronomers study the universe.
doesNotKnow: Standardized Type Ia supernova brightness provides distance estimates. Their distances and redshifts were evidence that cosmic expansion has accelerated in the recent universe.

misconception: A learner may choose: They proved every supernova has the same brightness without correction
objective: Use the visual model to reason about: How did distant Type Ia supernova observations contribute to the discovery of accelerated expansion?

claims.text: Question, correct answer and explanation: How did distant Type Ia supernova observations contribute to the discovery of accelerated expansion? They helped measure distances that were greater than expected in a nonaccelerating model. Standardized Type Ia supernova brightness provides distance estimates. Their distances and redshifts were evidence that cosmic expansion has accelerated in the recent universe.
Visual caption: Distance + redshift evidence. The SVG is a conceptual illustration, not measured data or a scale model.
